text: Some wars are fought over land or religion, sadly not every one.
History's dumbest wars were fought over a pig and a bucket.
I ranked them by stupidity, so settle in and enjoy the show.
Each story gets only a few seconds, so please do not blink.
Number one on our list is the Pig War of eighteen fifty-nine.
A British pig ate an American farmer's entire pile of beloved potatoes.
The farmer shot the pig, and then the neighbors started to argue.
Both powerful empires sent huge armies to the little San Juan Island.
The soldiers camped for twelve long years, eating and playing board games.
The only real casualty of the whole war was the poor pig.
